name: velero-restore-test-failures
description: Failures from velero restore-test CronJob in velero namespace.
filter: resource.type="k8s_container" AND resource.labels.namespace_name="velero" AND resource.labels.pod_name=~"^restore-test-" AND (severity>=ERROR OR textPayload:"FAIL" OR textPayload:"FAILED" OR textPayload:"ERROR" OR textPayload:"StartError" OR textPayload:"Back-off")
